analysis:
This source pass examined base lines 1-1255 of provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCache.swift. That range covers the config, stats, lifecycle/close, RAM-only lookup with ticket pinning, endAdoption reservation release, the donate path (adoption-bound plus benefit-floor gate, HMAC tags, persisted-run byte cap, endurance pre-check, write-behind submit) and the window sidecars. None of these lines are changed by the PR.

The complete range map shows the only change at base 1772-1787 / head 1772-1779, in evictOldestEntry. The head version adds a !isClosed guard before hasSafeRoot. Victim iteration is delegated to SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest(index:isClosed:), with a closure that calls retireIndexedEntries([url]). The evictions stat is incremented only when freed > 0.

This change narrows removal for a closed cache, which is consistent with close() deregistering from diskBudget (base line 461). Under T-041(b) this could at most make a closed cache stop contributing to the box-wide LRU budget; registered open caches still evict. The changed lines themselves are not in this batch's primary units, so I cannot verify the new helper (SSDOwnedEntryRetirement) here.

Integration must confirm three things about evictOldest:
- It preserves the base semantics: abort on retired.externalChange, skip victims that are valid but undeletable, and stay bounded by the index.oldestEntries() snapshot.
- It cannot loop unbounded or return a positive freed count without an unlink, which would mislead SSDDiskBudget enforcement (T-041 disk budget, T-016 availability).
- It does not weaken TTL or LRU purge for open caches.

No change to HMAC naming, AAD, the TTL, salt scoping or staging-reservation release paths is visible.
